data.summary:
The lecture discusses the development of generative AI in 2024, highlighting the emergence of LLM models and Tech Giants' competition in creating these models. It also introduces the concept of agentic AI, which has gained attention in the second half of the year, and explains that the video will cover what agentic AI is, how it differs from generative AI, and the frameworks used to create agentic AI applications.

The lecture introduces the concept of agentic AI, explaining how it differs from generative AI. The speaker discusses the use of large language models (LLMs) such as open-source LLMs and highlights the importance of prompts in determining the behavior of these models. The lecture aims to provide an understanding of agentic AI and its applications, with a focus on LLMs and their role in content creation.
